long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Bolshevo near Moscow in 1969, Sergey Alexandrovich Trudovoy emerged publicly as a furniture executive in the nearby city of Yubileyny. By 2008 he was chairman of the board of Stylish Kitchens, then one of Shchyolkovo district's leading furniture producers. That year he also made a self-nominated bid to lead the Yubileyny city district, although his candidacy was not registered.

After establishing himself in Monaco, Trudovoy broadened his business interests. For two years he managed and co-owned Le Relais des Amis before he and his wife sold all its shares. He later registered maritime and coastal freight as his principal individual business activity, alongside a residential-rental establishment in Cannes. His presidency of a Cannes property company added another local role, giving his later career a mix of hospitality, property and maritime services.
